# SC ALPR Overview

Automated license plate readers (ALPR) are deployed across South Carolina by
multiple law-enforcement agencies. [[Flock Safety]] is the dominant vendor. See
the [[_MOC|Surveillance MOC]] for the full map of related notes.

Open questions: which agencies operate the cameras, how many, and under what
legal authority they retain and share the plate data.
